content: zod latest 4.5.4. Zod 4 has built-in z.toJSONSchema() (no more zod-to-json-schema dep) for producing JSON Schema to feed LLM tool/function definitions. AI SDK v5+ accepts Zod 4 schemas directly in generateObject/tool(). Use z.safeParse on model output + one repair round-trip as the provider-agnostic guardrail.
